description: A vintage-style adjustable stool with a wooden seat and backrest. The metal frame has a dark, weathered finish with hints of rust, giving it an industrial or workshop aesthetic. The seat and backrest are made of light-colored wood with a visible grain. The stool features a central threaded mechanism for adjusting the height, controlled by two knobs on the side. A circular metal footrest connects the four legs, providing stability. This stool appears to be designed for functional use, likely in a workshop, bar, or studio setting where its adjustable height and durable construction would be beneficial.
